summary.text: Joel A. Greff is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Dontavius Jarrells is also running.
An IT consultant, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he aims to bring fiscal responsibility and accountability to the district.

paragraphs.text: Joel A. Greff graduated from Bexley High School, earned a bachelor's degree from The Ohio State University in 1988 and a graduate degree from Franklin University in 1993.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in East Columbus, has been part of the Bexley community for decades, and is a lifelong Franklin County resident.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
Greff listed prosperity, education and affordability as the three key messages of his campaign.
He said he supports school choice and cleaning up the charter school system, and wants to expand skilled trades programs.
